name: rpg-engine-dev-desktop
description: Electron desktop wrapper for the RPG Engine (dev). Loads the Expo web export (react-native-web) so the full dev engine — narrator included — runs on PC. Separate npm package from the mobile app so it never affects the RN build. Mirrors the live-Tartaria steam_Dev wrapper, minus the Steam/store integration.

scripts._comment: From repo root: `npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist` produces dist/, then `bash scripts/harden-web-bundle.sh dist`, then copy dist/* into desktop/web-build/. Then run these. The build-engine-exe.yml workflow does all of this automatically on push to Dev_engine_PC.
